MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Audio Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket
